motivationalQuotes: Strive forward, and life will be wonderful.

siteAiReply.greeting: Hi! I'm Burkit, the Codo Hub AI assistant. I can find a similar project on this site and create a new one from it, or show you the right section of the site. What would you like to do?
siteAiReply.thanks: You're welcome! Write any time you need help.
siteAiReply.help: Here is what I can do: search the site for similar projects, create a new project based on one, and point you to site sections (upload, chat, Vibecoding, profile, settings). For example:
siteAiReply.about: I'm Burkit (Kazakh for “golden eagle”), the Codo Hub AI assistant. Like an eagle, I look from above, find the project you need on the site and point you to the right section.

whatIs.title: Who are we?
whatIs.description: Codo Hub is a code sharing and collaboration platform for Kazakhstani developers. We help develop the Kazakhstani IT community and knowledge exchange.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: Our mission is to create a convenient platform for Kazakhstani developers for code sharing, knowledge exchange, and collaboration. We support open source and rely on community development.
